metadata.title: HE 0437-5439 -- an unbound hyper-velocity main-sequence B-type star

evidence.quote: We report the discovery of a second hyper-velocity star,

Its galactic rest frame velocity is at least 563 km s<sup>−1</sup>, almost twice the local
Galactic escape velocity, indicating that the star is unbound to the Galaxy.

the escape velocity at the position of HE 0437−5439 is 317 km s<sup>−1</sup> indicating
that the star is unbound to the Galaxy.

notes: HE 0437−5439: The authors explicitly retain that the star is unbound to the Galaxy because its Galactic rest-frame velocity (at least 563 km s−1) exceeds the local escape velocity; at its position the adopted Galactic potential gives an escape velocity of 317 km s−1 (T:p1-b15, T:p5-b4). The velocity is a lower limit because zero proper motion was assumed (T:p5-b4).

HE 0437−5439: The 61 kpc distance in T:p1-b15 is the same result reported with an error as 61 ± 12 kpc in T:p5-b3; only the latter is entered. T:p7-b1 reports a radial velocity of 461 km/s relative to the LMC and a total predicted proper motion of about 2 mas/yr relative to the LMC; neither is a heliocentric/barycentric radial velocity or an equatorial component proper-motion value, so they are not entered. The predicted component proper motions from T:p6-b1 are conditional on a Galactic-center origin. No parallax, Galactocentric radius, or numerical bound/unbound probability is reported; T:p5-b4 only states that the star is unbound.
